nodes.description: Private nested mapping(address => mapping(string => Datum)) storing the most recent authenticated price datum per source and key.
Public mapping(bytes32 => uint) of official 6-decimal prices keyed by symbol hash.
Circuit breaker flag; when true the anchor price is used directly and reporter prices are ignored.
Mapping(bytes32 => Observation) holding the lagging uniswap accumulator window per symbol hash.
Mapping(bytes32 => Observation) holding the current uniswap accumulator window per symbol hash.
Immutable minimum number of seconds before the uniswap accumulator window is rotated.
Immutable reference to the OpenOraclePriceData contract used as the reporter price source.
Immutable address of the trusted Open Oracle reporter whose signatures authorize price writes.
Immutable upper bound on anchorPrice/reporterPrice, computed with an overflow guard.
Immutable lower bound on anchorPrice/reporterPrice, computed with an underflow guard.
Immutable number of token configs actually supplied at construction; bounds index lookups.
Immutable UniswapAnchoredView used by the v1 compatibility adapter.
Immutable WETH address that short-circuits the adapter lookup to the ETH config.
Public pure function that recovers the signer address of a message/signature pair via ecrecover.
External entry point that decodes a signed message and stores the resulting datum.
Internal writer that only updates storage when the message timestamp is newer than stored and within block.timestamp + 60 minutes.
Internal pure decoder that recovers the source and abi.decodes the message payload, enforcing kind == 'prices'.
External view returning (timestamp, value) for a source/key pair from the data mapping.
External view returning only the price value for a source/key pair.
Constructor that freezes up to maxTokens TokenConfig entries into immutable slots.
Internal helper returning the i-th config or a zeroed default when out of range.
Internal view performing a linear scan of cToken immutables, returning uint(-1) when absent.
Internal view performing a linear scan of underlying immutables, returning uint(-1) when absent.
Internal view performing a linear scan of symbolHash immutables, returning uint(-1) when absent.
Public view returning the TokenConfig for index i after requiring i < numTokens.
Public view hashing a symbol string and resolving its config.
Public view resolving a config from a symbol hash via getSymbolHashIndex/getTokenConfig.
Public view resolving a config by cToken and falling back to an external underlying() call on an arbitrary address.
Public view resolving a config by underlying asset, reverting when not found.
Library function computing a uq112x112 ratio, reverting on a zero denominator.
Library function decoding a uq112x112 value into an 18-decimal uint.
Library view wrapping block.timestamp into a uint32.
Library view reading uniswap pair accumulators and counterfactually extrapolating them to the current timestamp.
Constructor setting reporter state, anchor tolerance bounds and seeding uniswap observation windows from block.timestamp.
External view returning the official USD price of a symbol.
Internal view dispatching on PriceSource to return the reporter, fixed, or ETH-derived price.
External view implementing the Compound PriceOracle interface with 18-decimal scaling.
External entry point accepting arbitrary user messages/signatures, forwarding them to priceData and refreshing stored prices.
Internal routine fetching the reporter price, the anchor price and deciding whether to store, override, or guard the price.
Internal view bounding reporter deviation from the anchor via the upper/lower bound ratios.
Internal view selecting the cumulative accumulator for the configured uniswap market.
Internal function fetching the ETH/USD anchor price with ethBaseUnit scaling.
Internal virtual function computing the time-weighted uniswap anchor price from accumulator deltas.
Internal function rotating old/new observation windows once anchorPeriod has elapsed.
External function allowing the reporter to permanently fall back to anchor prices by signing a 'rotate' message.
Public pure signature recovery shadowing the base implementation, used to authenticate reporter invalidation.
Internal overflow-proof multiplication helper using a division round-trip check.
Constructor storing the anchored view and WETH address for the v1 adapter.
Public view returning the token price denominated in ETH using the anchored view.
Public view v1 compatibility shim forwarding to getPrices.
Internal overflow-proof multiplication helper duplicated in the adapter.
Miner-influenced block timestamp used for staleness checks, uniswap window rotation and TWAP elapsed time.
Signature recovery with user-supplied r, s, v and malleability/garbage-signature concerns.
Raw abi.decode of attacker-controlled message and signature blobs without length validation.
Division by the reserve denominator inside FixedPoint.fraction, guarded only by a require.
Unchecked multiplication followed by a division verification; the round-trip check is the only overflow guard.
Comparison timestamp < block.timestamp + 60 minutes that gates authenticated storage writes.
(nowCumulativePrice - oldCumulativePrice) / timeElapsed; relies on desired underflow of accumulators and nonzero elapsed time.
CErc20(cToken).underlying() call on a caller-supplied address, enabling arbitrary external call reentrancy/DoS.
External priceData.put call executed for every user-supplied message inside postPrices.
Caller-supplied message bytes that are hashed and recovered from a signature.
Caller-supplied signature blob decoded into r, s and v.
Storage pointer to the previously stored Datum for the source/key pair.
Message timestamp supplied inside the signed payload, checked against block.timestamp.
Message key string used as the second mapping index.
TokenConfig memory struct driving price source dispatch.
Caller-supplied symbol string resolved to a config and symbol hash.
Caller-supplied cToken address used for config lookup and price retrieval.
block.timestamp - oldTimestamp, the divisor for the uniswap TWAP delta.
Price read back from priceData for the trusted reporter.
Uniswap-derived anchor price compared against the reporter price.
Current cumulative uniswap accumulator used when rotating observation windows.
